## Recovery steps

Scripts are in `cursor-recovery/`. To restore the chat:

1. **Quit Cursor** (Cmd+Q or `pkill -9 -f Cursor`).

2. **Add the chat to the workspaces where it’s missing:**
   ```bash
   cd "/Users/samgu/All things TAMS/CSCE/2110/cursor-recovery"
   python3 fix_sidebar.py c5ea810c-a2ba-4bc4-a881-b4bd9e51d41d 1cf5bef6f90a2faa101c87d74998b061
   python3 fix_sidebar.py c5ea810c-a2ba-4bc4-a881-b4bd9e51d41d 4c419c162d065934f0476fdc6bdcb6e7
   ```

3. **If the chat appears but messages are empty** (status was `aborted`):
   ```bash
   python3 fix_bubble_headers.py c5ea810c-a2ba-4bc4-a881-b4bd9e51d41d
   ```

4. **Reopen Cursor.**

The chat is already in the sidebar for workspace `85dcbd475fdb9e8d9b757c19586947d6` (CSCE/2110). If you’re using a different CSCE/2110 workspace, run the `fix_sidebar.py` commands above so it shows there too.

**Important:** Cursor overwrites DB changes made while it’s running, so it must be fully closed before running these scripts. See the [forum guide](https://forum.cursor.com/t/how-i-recovered-my-vanished-cursor-chat-so-you-dont-have-to/151158) for more detail.
